name: Client Studio
description: Company assistant on a Supabase-backed workspace: answers questions from supplied text or Markdown with exact source excerpts. Splits sources into versions, filters internal sources from the customer view on the server, and goes live only after explicit review, approval and activation as a frozen snapshot. Writes are revision-checked and idempotent, and the database is closed to client roles so only the server can read or write.
keyFeatures: Answers from supplied text or Markdown with exact source excerpts
Versioned sources
Server-side filtering of internal sources from the customer view
Explicit review, approval and activation as a frozen snapshot
Revision-checked, idempotent writes
architecture: Next.js application on a Supabase-backed workspace; the database is closed to client roles so only the server can read or write.
details: Live demo at https://client-studio-psi.vercel.app/. Retrieval is lexical and model calls are switched off in the hosted demo. Shown with fictional examples or user-provided material. Source is private.

name: Active Companion
description: Meeting-assistant lab in Python: a sliding context window, heuristic intent classification and TF-IDF retrieval turn a transcript into evidence cards with named sources. An optional model step keeps only answer bullets that cite a retrieved source title. Includes a server-sent-events API lab and provider-free automated tests, with public MIT-licensed source.
keyFeatures: Sliding context window
Heuristic intent classification
TF-IDF retrieval into evidence cards with named sources
Optional model step keeps only bullets that cite a retrieved source title
Provider-free automated tests
architecture: Transcript pipeline: sliding context window, intent classification, TF-IDF retrieval, evidence cards, optional cited model step.
details: Scripted replay at https://active-companion-replay.vercel.app/; public MIT-licensed source at https://github.com/pappdavid/active-companion. The hosted page is a scripted replay of the pipeline output for four fictional conversations, with no inference, microphone or uploads. It is not evaluated on real meetings. The model step runs only in the local lab and is tested with a stubbed model.

name: Faultline
description: Executable browser model of retries and idempotency: lose the request before commit or the response after it, see the duplicate effect of a naive retry, then replay against an idempotent receiver. The receiver stores the operation key and payload fingerprint and rejects a changed payload under the same key. Events, receipts and assertions come from a tested in-memory engine with public source.
keyFeatures: Lose the request before commit or the response after it
Duplicate effect of a naive retry
Idempotent receiver stores the operation key and payload fingerprint
Changed payload under the same key is rejected
architecture: A deterministic engine models client attempts, receiver state, stored receipts, and the resulting completion/uniqueness assertions.
details: Public no-login simulation at /faultline/index.html. No network calls or real bookings. Atomic effect-and-receipt storage is a model assumption. It is a teaching model in browser JavaScript, not a deployed service or a test of real distributed systems.

name: Mercury Renderer Study
description: Frontend rendering study using bundled synthetic full-state snapshots; no model calls.
keyFeatures: Play, pause, and scrub synthetic sequences
Malformed-frame rejection with last-valid state retention
Stable SVG node reconciliation
Bounded event trace export
architecture: Bundled fixtures pass through schema validation before text and SVG node updates; invalid frames preserve the last valid composition.
details: Public no-login replay at /demos/mercury/index.html. Inspired by diffusion-style updates; no Mercury model connection, inference, or performance benchmark.

name: VoidArch Context
description: Local-first, agent-neutral repository memory, query, and context-pack engine.
keyFeatures: Embedded per-repository SurrealDB
File and document retrieval with BM25
Tree-sitter code graph
Durable memories, tasks, and blockers
Optional local embeddings
Deterministic token-budgeted context packs
architecture: Repository files, docs, graph nodes, vectors, and memories are fused into a bounded context pack for any coding agent.
fileStructure: CLI commands for init, ingest, search, graph, memory, embed, context, doctor, and serve
details: Runs locally without Docker or Python. The embedded database is single-process and vector retrieval requires an explicit embedding pass.

name: VoidArch Studio
description: Active-development local orchestration control room built on VoidArch Context.
keyFeatures: Daemon-owned Claude, Codex, and shell PTYs
Session transcripts and resume metadata
Worktree and run management
Safety hooks and observability
Local web dashboard and thin Tauri shell
architecture: A local dashboard and desktop shell communicate with a daemon that owns sessions, worktrees, runs, hooks, and Context access.
details: In active development; not presented as a released hosted service.
